chunks: Only they can reach it who are clean (of mind).
ai.seo_question: Who is eligible to touch or comprehend the Quran according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the debate between the literalist view of ritual purity (taharah) and the spiritual interpretation, where 'al-Mutahharun' refers to the Ahl al-Bayt, the purified household of the Prophet. This understanding is deeply rooted in the verse of purification (33:33) and highlights that true comprehension of the Quran requires both physical cleanliness and spiritual immaculacy inherited from the Imams.
